demo_extraction.scope_summary: Upgrade the campus LAN and WAN, including structured cabling across six blocks. Install managed switches, firewalls and campus-wide Wi-Fi. Provide network monitoring, documentation and a one year warranty.

eligibility.requirement: Valid NTN and active ATL status
eligibility.source_quote: The bidder must hold a valid National Tax Number (NTN) and appear on the FBR Active Taxpayers List (ATL).

eligibility.requirement: Minimum annual turnover of PKR 25 million during the last financial year.
eligibility.source_quote: Minimum annual turnover of PKR 25 million during the last financial year.

eligibility.requirement: The bidder must have been in business for at least 3 years.
eligibility.source_quote: The bidder must have been in business for at least 3 years.
The bidder must have completed at least one network infrastructure project worth PKR 10 million or more.
Affidavit on stamp paper that the bidder has not been blacklisted by any government body.
Bid security in the form of a pay order or bank guarantee shall accompany the financial bid.
